about.title: About Me
about.text:
I have a passion for fauna and flora. I love walking around the garden looking at plants, leaves, bugs and flowers, and I struggle to walk past a pet without trying to befriend it.

Sometimes I wish I could pull them out from the paper for five minutes to give them a cuddle before sending them home.

orderText: Send me your photo (the original file, not a screenshot), your chosen size and medium, your pet's name, your delivery address, and any deadline. Once we've agreed on the photo, a 50% non-refundable deposit secures your place on my waiting list. Your portrait is posted once the final payment clears.
